clips.title: The story
paras: In Warsong Gulch, soldiers fight for Ashenvale while commanders honor their sacrifices. Capital officers accept the Ribbon of Sacrifice as a sign of steadfast service, even when battles bring no clear victory.

The Silverwing Sentinels and Warsong Outriders fight brutal skirmishes along Ashenvale’s southern border. Many battles end without a clear victory. Stormwind, Orgrimmar, and other capitals honor those who hold their ground despite the odds. The Ribbon of Sacrifice marks fighters who gave themselves to the struggle.

Far from the front, Alliance Brigadier Generals and Horde Warbringers oversee their forces. Recruiters send new fighters to Warsong Gulch, while quartermasters and tacticians account for veterans returning from hard campaigns. By honoring courage in stalemate or defeat, their leaders help keep soldiers committed to holding Ashenvale.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, yes! Of course we wouldn't forget about your past accomplishments in Warsong Gulch.
